name: displays_list
description: Enumerate active Windows displays, including IDD virtual monitors. Returns connection-scoped display references, device names and physical desktop bounds. Re-list invalidates old display references. Does not install or enable a driver.

name: display_capture
description: Capture a real PNG from a selected physical or IDD virtual display without activating a window. Default is the full display. A supplied region uses global desktop physical pixels and must fit entirely inside it; at most 16 megapixels.

name: window_to_display
description: Restore a minimized/maximized target, then move it 16 pixels inside a selected display and shrink it if needed. Uses real Win32 actions; returns previous and current geometry. Partial changes may remain if the app rejects resizing. Shared Windows focus/cursor; not a separate session.

name: windows_list
description: Enumerate visible Win32 windows, optionally filter titles case-insensitively. Returns scoped target references; invalidates previous references.

name: window_control
description: Direct Win32 window state/geometry control. Close posts WM_CLOSE, which may prompt to save; no force kill. All actions validate original HWND/process/thread identity.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

name: capture
description: Activate target and return its visible region on the selected display (default primary). PNG metadata uses Windows desktop physical pixels. Not offscreen rendering.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

display.description: Display reference from the latest displays_list in this connection; re-list after topology changes. Omit to use the primary monitor.

name: locate
description: Activate target and find one template in its visible selected-display region (default primary). Returns desktop physical coordinates, possibly negative. Multiple/no matches fail. Exact and confidence are mutually exclusive.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

display.description: Display reference from the latest displays_list in this connection; re-list after topology changes. Omit to use the primary monitor.

name: click_image
description: Recognize one image then recheck pixels, foreground and geometry before sending a real click. Inspect capture first; template must be distinctive.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

display.description: Display reference from the latest displays_list in this connection; re-list after topology changes. Omit to use the primary monitor.

name: type_text
description: Activate target and send Unicode text to the focused control. Rechecks foreground for every character. Partial text may be sent before cancellation/failure.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

text.description: Text to enter; no shell evaluation

name: hotkey
description: Activate target and send a chord, releasing all keys afterwards (e.g. [ctrl,a] or [enter]). Verify the focused control before input.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

name: screensaver
description: Read screensaver status, pause auto-start, resume or stop an active .scr saver. Pause restores on timer, resume or MCP disconnection. Does not unlock Windows or change password/lock policy.
